name: @intent-wallet/plugins
description: Plugin Marketplace & Extension SDK — the security foundation that turns the platform into an ecosystem. Third parties extend it WITHOUT modifying core: a plugin proposes, deterministic code verifies, the device signature disposes. Capability-based permissions where keys/signing/DB access are structurally ABSENT from the vocabulary (a plugin can't request what it can never be given); TRUST LEVELS (official/verified/community/experimental) that cap permissions and drive warnings; plugin signing + code-hash integrity + authorized-signer + revocation (supply-chain); semver compatibility + dependency resolution; a sandbox capability gate + resource limits; a lifecycle state machine with health-driven auto-suspend; and event-subscription authorization. The isolate runtime, scanners, store and CLI are infra; this is the deterministic policy core they enforce.
